Natural Geode Specimen Lot - 7 Pieces
Quartz Crystal Mineral Specimens
Rough Natural Formations
This collection features seven natural geode and crystal specimens displaying varied geological crystalline formations. This lot showcases diverse textures, hollow vugs lined with sparkling quartz druse, and rugged weathered exterior rinds ideal for geological study, education, or natural specimen display.
Items Included:
Large open geode half with prominent central cavity of quartz crystals
Open geode specimen displaying deep crystal-lined hollow pocket
Natural crystalline cluster fragment with exposed quartz points
Rounded geode nodule with textured outer host rock matrix
Miniature hollow geode with druzy crystal interior
Matrix rock specimen section with exposed crystalline pocket
Geode half featuring translucent to white quartz crystal cavity lining
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in rough, raw condition. All pieces retain their natural mineral surfaces, crystalline formations, and outer matrix without modern lapidary polishing. Natural earth dust, minor fracturing, and rough exterior edges inherent to raw mineral specimens.

If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.

Failure to pick up your package at the hold location results in the package being returned to us. You will then have to pay new shipping charges if you want your item re-shipped. Collection of Rough Rock Salt Mineral Specimens Natural Pink Hues 2.6 lbs
This listing includes a collection of rough rock salt mineral specimens, often mistaken for rose quartz due to their pink hues. The stones are unpolished and vary in size and shape, exhibiting natural pink colors with occasional white and reddish-brown inclusions. The material is translucent with a crystalline structure. Some pieces show surface imperfections or mineral deposits typical of raw rock salt. These specimens are in their natural, unprocessed condition and are suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, crafts, décor, or metaphysical uses. Lot weighs approximately 2.6 lbs

description: This lot includes two raw apophyllite mineral specimens. The left specimen measures 3x2.5x1 inches and the right specimen measures 2.5x1.5x1.25 inches. Both crystals have a colorless to milky white appearance with transparent to translucent qualities and well-defined hexagonal faces. The larger cluster is roughly oval-shaped while the smaller one is more irregular. Natural matrix is present on the underside, with one piece showing greenish mineralization. The combined weight of both specimens is 232.8 grams. These specimens are in raw, unpolished condition. Due to the softer nature and raw edges of apophyllite, flaking or cracks on the edges may be present. No obvious damage is noted. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.

description:
Circa 1920s-30s - Length: 2-3/4”
The Cap & Barrel: The engraving reads "18KT - 1/10 GOLD FILLED". This indicates a high-grade manufacturing process where a thick layer of solid 18-karat gold is mechanically bonded to a base metal core. In the 1920s, a 1/10 fractional ratio was exceptionally generous, meaning 10% of the total overlay metal's weight is true gold (more common vintage pens often used a thinner 1/20 ratio).\n• The Nib: The stamp confirms it is a solid 14-karat gold nib. Nibs from this era especially those coming from former Waterman craftsmen are highly celebrated among modern collectors for their impressive smoothness and flexible expression.

Vintage Hemingray glass telegraph/telephone pole insulator in aqua/teal blue color. Features embossed 'HEMINGRAY-42' lettering and beaded skirt design around the base.
